notes: Pilot has 3 fixed POSTER/C pairs; no target score changes method, budget or candidate.

POSTER B freezes C source encoder and trains two reset dense projection layers plus reset head for 10 epochs; the projection is retained in C. Projection dimensions differ from original POSTER to match each C embedding.
Pilot pass means fixed predictions and independent scores complete with finite metrics and nonempty per-class query; no superiority criterion or target-dependent selection.
P01/MIX01/1-1 is an exposed development episode; Hu cross-backbone binding remains unfinished.
ISSL remains stopped; CSIL author binding unavailable; external support/query are raw and DURA-free.
